name: BiospecimenIdentifier
label: Biospecimen identifier
description: A unique proper name or character sequence that identifies this particular biospecimen. (NCIT:C93400)

name: DerivedFromMaterial
label: Derived from material
description: Identifies the parent biological Material entity from which this biospecimen directly or indirectly originates, either as a physical portion (aliquot) or as a derived fraction (e.g., extracted DNA, serum, tissue section). (RO:0001000)

name: BiospecimenForm
label: Biospecimen Form
description: The specific physical form, fraction, or analyte derived from the parent material (e.g., extracted genomic DNA, total RNA, serum, cell lysate, or FFPE section) prepared for downstream analysis or sequencing. (NCIT:C70713)

name: PercentageTumorCells
label: Percentage tumor cells
description: The percentage of tumor cells compared to total cells present in this material. (NCIT:C123556)

name: Quantity
label: Quantity
description: The total count or number of available physical units, aliquots, blocks, or slides representing this specific biospecimen instance. (NCIT:C25256)

name: StorageConditions
label: Storage conditions
description: The environmental temperature and preservation parameter under which the biospecimen is maintained in the repository. (NCIT:C96145)

name: ManagingBiobank
label: Managing biobank
description: The organization or facility that owns, manages, and physically stores this biospecimen or slide, maintaining custody and responsibility for its storage conditions and associated data. (NCIT:C48800)

name: Availability
label: Availability
description: The current operational or inventory status indicating whether the biospecimen is available for research, reserved, depleted, or destroyed. (NCIT:C25429)

name: NameOfFixative
label: Name of fixative
description: The name of the compound that preserves tissues and cells for microscopic study. (NCIT:C128948)

name: EmbeddingMedium
label: Embedding medium
description: A material that infiltrates and supports a specimen and preserves its shape and structure for sectioning and microscopy. (NCIT:C113307)
